test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**agreements**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Agreements**" can cover a wide range of commitments between parties, including financial investment, collaboration terms, etc., making it a versatile choice
 
• In the context of Shark Tank, where entrepreneurs and investors discuss potential partnerships, "agreements" accurately represents the formal or informal contracts made.
 
• Choosing "agreements" supports the theme of new ventures forming through collaborations, which are formalized through agreements.

Hence, the revised correct answer is ‘**Option 1**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the other words
 
• **Agreements**: These are mutual arrangements, typically in written form, between parties with regards to a particular line of action.
 
 
• **Example**: The two companies signed an agreement to merge.
 
 
 
• **Promises**: This refers to a declaration or assurance that one will do something or that a particular thing will happen.
 
 
• **Example**: He made a promise to return the book next week.
 
 
 
• **Association**: This means a group of people organized for a joint purpose.
 
 
• **Example**: She is a member of the local business association
